name: @ship/sui-site
description: The SUI docs site — a deck app: docs, the 25-lesson tutorial, the component library, and an interactive component playground. SUI's own red identity, light + dark.

scripts.gen: node scripts/gen-manifest.mjs && node scripts/gen-tutorial.mjs && node scripts/gen-tutorial-host.mjs && bun scripts/gen-tut-primitives.mjs && cp ../../packages/sui/compiler-wasm/pkg/sui_compiler_bg.wasm public/sui_compiler_bg.wasm 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev: bun run gen && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli -- dev --project apps/sui-site --addr 127.0.0.1:7878)
scripts.build: bun run gen && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli -- build --project apps/sui-site --base assets --bundle-framework)
